reproduction.identity: Explicit synthetic session gate; persisted roleMap resolved by actual resolve()
reproduction.scheduling: Pass-through transaction wrapper revokes the fixture session only after the actual authenticated snapshot transaction returns; it does not replace the domain, export producer, callback or returned bytes.
reproduction.positive_control: Authorized real DOCX generated and parsed through JSZip + Saxes
reproduction.failure_evidence: Before asserting403, records exact actual DOCX bytes and digest if the unpatched route returns200; confirms the next request receives401 and compares persisted snapshots to prove reads did not mutate data.

change.behavior: After generation and before response creation, open a fresh read transaction and reauthenticate the same Request against current roles. A missing/changed actor suppresses bytes with403. Changed public source data/versions suppress bytes with409; no automatic retry.
change.boundary: Initial captured source digest excludes private __sfProductV1 and read audits; revalidation does not regenerate or mutate files and does not repeat effects.
change.tradeoff: Source comparison conservatively covers all public data and versions on the exported surface. Unrelated concurrent public edits may require an explicit fresh download.
